An '''inertial tracking device''' was a type of [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]]. One was issued to [[Green squad]] of [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]]' during a mission to install a [[Bug (surveillance)|bugging device]] under the [[Imperial Communications Center (Iyuta)|Imperial Communications Center]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iyuta]].<ref name="Plant" />
